steps.title: Make a hoe
steps.say: Make a wooden hoe at a crafting table with 2 planks and 2 sticks. A stone or iron hoe works too.

steps.title: Collect wheat seeds
steps.say: Break grass to find wheat seeds. Only some grass drops a seed, so keep going until you have a handful.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.say: Pick a flat grassy spot and dig 1 hole in the middle. Fill a bucket at a lake or river and pour the water in.

steps.title: Hoe the ground
steps.say: Use your hoe on the ground all around the water to make farmland. Water keeps farmland wet up to 4 blocks away in every direction.

steps.title: Plant the seeds
steps.say: Place 1 seed on each farmland block. Walk on your farm but never jump, because jumping on farmland turns it back into dirt.

steps.title: Protect your farm
steps.say: Build a fence with a gate around your farm to keep mobs from trampling it. Put torches on the fence posts so monsters don't spawn nearby.

steps.title: Speed it up
steps.say: Wheat takes time to grow. Use bone meal on a wheat plant to help it grow faster. You can make bone meal from a bone.

steps.title: Harvest and replant
steps.say: When the wheat turns brown, break it to get wheat and usually some seeds. Plant seeds back in each spot. 3 wheat make 1 bread!
